assertions.claim: Without a written agreement, default: wages/bonuses, business and investment income, IP income, inherited and gifted property acquired in marriage are jointly owned
assertions.cn_span: 法律默认婚后挣的工资奖金、经营和投资收益、知识产权收益、继承或受赠的财产都归两人共有

assertions.claim: Personal property: premarital assets, personal-injury compensation, property a will or gift contract gives to one spouse only, personal-use items
assertions.cn_span: 婚前财产、人身损害赔偿、遗嘱或赠与合同写明只给一方的、一方专用的生活用品才是个人的

assertions.claim: Spouses may agree in writing to separate or partial ownership; the agreement is binding; notarization not required
assertions.cn_span: 双方可以书面约定各归各或部分共有，签了就有约束力，公证不是必要条件

assertions.claim: The spouse who bore more childcare/elder-care may claim compensation at divorce
assertions.cn_span: 因带孩子、照料老人多付出的一方，离婚时可以要求补偿

assertions.claim: No official statistics for bride price, weddings, home purchase; no numbers given in this item
assertions.cn_span: 彩礼、婚礼、婚房没有官方统计，本条不写数字

assertions.claim: The property agreement cuts both ways — useful for the higher earner and for the one doing more unpaid work
assertions.cn_span: 财产约定是双向的，对收入高的一方和承担无酬劳动多的一方都有用

assertions.claim: Article 1088 compensation amount: by agreement between the parties, failing that by court; no statutory formula
assertions.cn_span: 第一千零八十八条的补偿金额由双方协议、协议不成由法院判，没有法定公式
